groups.name: initial-lag40
groups.spokenClause: A request scheduled at seven hundred sixty milliseconds and sent at eight hundred is forty milliseconds late

groups.name: baseline-clock
groups.spokenClause: Schedule lag is five milliseconds, while send-relative time to first token is two hundred eighty-five

groups.name: changed-clock
groups.spokenClause: The apparent first-token wait falls to two hundred fifty milliseconds, while lag rises to forty

groups.name: changed-fidelity
groups.spokenClause: With our twenty-millisecond lag limit, the run now fails schedule fidelity

groups.name: occupancy2-7
groups.spokenClause: Our supplied periodic example averages two point seven active requests over three seconds, matching three requests per second times zero point nine seconds

groups.name: cohort-horizon
groups.spokenClause: The finite cohort horizon runs from the window start through the later of window end and last terminal outcome: here two point five seconds

groups.name: ttft240
groups.spokenClause: Its first observed token arrives at two hundred forty, so time to first token is two hundred forty milliseconds

groups.name: tpot60
groups.spokenClause: Time per output token averages these gaps to sixty milliseconds

groups.name: e2e500
groups.spokenClause: End-to-end latency includes that final wait and ends at five hundred milliseconds

groups.name: single170
groups.spokenClause: Its first-token wait is one hundred seventy milliseconds

groups.name: single-null
groups.spokenClause: There are zero inter-token intervals, so its TPOT is undefined

groups.name: playback40
groups.spokenClause: Compare three hundred, three hundred eighty, four hundred sixty, five hundred eighty and six hundred twenty: mean TPOT is eighty, yet token four is forty milliseconds late

groups.name: attainment50
groups.spokenClause: Attainment is three of six, or fifty percent

groups.name: success-rate2
groups.spokenClause: Over the two-point-five-second cohort horizon, that is two successful requests per second and one point two qualified requests per second

groups.name: qualified-rate1-2
groups.spokenClause: Over the two-point-five-second cohort horizon, that is two successful requests per second and one point two qualified requests per second

groups.name: missing-outcome
groups.spokenClause: The scorer rejects the missing terminal outcome instead of letting attainment improve

groups.name: changed-quality4

groups.name: scorer-delay-fail
groups.spokenClause: The accounting is still available, and its first-token wait looks shorter, but schedule validity fails

groups.name: useful-first
groups.spokenClause: One hundred ninety qualified gives about one point four three useful requests per second

groups.name: useful-second
groups.spokenClause: At two offered per second, one hundred sixty qualify over one hundred seconds, giving one point six

groups.name: occupancy15
groups.spokenClause: In a supplied three-replica scenario, one point five requests per second times ten seconds gives fifteen average active requests, or five per replica

groups.name: replicas20
groups.spokenClause: For one hundred active requests of that same mix, the ideal arithmetic gives twenty replicas

groups.name: rank19
groups.spokenClause: Thus p95 of twenty values selects the nineteenth, while p99 of eighty selects the maximum

groups.name: pooled1
groups.spokenClause: The pooled twenty-gap p95 is one millisecond

groups.name: request100
groups.spokenClause: Across the two per-request worst gaps, one and one hundred, nearest-rank p95 is one hundred

groups.name: average50-5
groups.spokenClause: Averaging the two runs’ p95 summaries would give fifty point five, which reconstructs neither pooled distribution

groups.name: wilson91-8
groups.spokenClause: Under the fixture’s independent-trial assumptions, a one-sided ninety-five-percent Wilson lower bound is ninety-one point eight percent

groups.name: perfect98-7
groups.spokenClause: Two hundred perfect trials give about ninety-eight point seven percent; twenty perfect trials give only eighty-eight point one

groups.name: small88-1
groups.spokenClause: Two hundred perfect trials give about ninety-eight point seven percent; twenty perfect trials give only eighty-eight point one

groups.name: fleet30
groups.spokenClause: The ideal hundred-active budget rises from twenty to thirty replicas

groups.name: fresh75
groups.spokenClause: Attainment is six of eight, or seventy-five percent

groups.name: fresh-qualified1-5
groups.spokenClause: Qualified cohort goodput is six divided by four, or one point five per second

groups.name: fresh-success1-75
groups.spokenClause: successful goodput is seven divided by four, or one point seven five

groups.name: fresh-offered3-2
groups.spokenClause: Offered arrival-window rate is eight divided by two point five, or three point two

groups.name: fresh-exit2
